audit: Stage2 A02 conditional_dependency train consolidated audit (revised canonical re-audit)

auditor_changes: Use per-document unique character features for document frequency in NFKC/casefold character 3-5 gram TF-IDF.
Compact sparse vocabulary indices, validate CSR structure, and calculate cosine similarity in float64.
Vectorize sparse pair iteration while retaining exhaustive comparison coverage.
Emit Windows console output as UTF-8 so concept-family text cannot abort report serialization.
Use the canonical set-digest formula: concatenate sorted per-file SHA-256 hexadecimal strings without filenames or separators, then hash.
Gate actual validation collisions rather than counting validation records as failures.
Exclude Korean copular endings such as 이다 and 이며 from the 이/가 mismatch detector.

data_drift_check.conclusion: No A02 data repair was required; only audit calculations and report values were revised.

set_digest_revision.reason: Digest formula normalization; every individual file SHA remained unchanged.

과와.classification: normal noun ending plus particle, such as 결과와/통과와

이가.classification: normal noun ending plus subject particle, such as 차이가/길이가

other_type_note: other was not used; no frequent other concept type exists

template_fingerprint_diagnostic.interpretation: generic lexical-shape fingerprint is diagnostic only; exact five-word repetition and fuzzy thresholds are the semantic boilerplate gates
